body:
Founder real-time: 'we want that for SHANKPIT so we can start making that experience better... we need that bot pool with like 3 bots so i can join up and get into a game.' Checked first: the live process on :6969 was shankpit-460's own separate, stale fork (frozen 2026-08-26, 902-line server vs this repo's actively-developed 1271 lines -- missing all recent TDMO/sprays/lighting/QUEUE work). Cleanly stopped+disabled the old shankpit460-server.service + shankpit460-emily-bot.service (kept, not deleted -- real rollback path), brought up new shankpit-server.service (this repo's own binary, same standard port) + shankpit-bot-pool.service (3 real emily-bot processes requesting the new MODE_QUEUE). Live-verified post-cutover: 3 real bot connections, all active/welcomed, sustained real traffic. Also rebuilt and hand-delivered a fresh Windows client with the QUEUE menu tile so the founder can actually join. Commits SHANKPIT 0c4c263 (+ ab506e3 changelog).

⚓ ☃
title: Live cutover: active SHANKPIT server + 3-bot QUEUE pool now serve production :6969
